mapper.insert: INSERT INTO memory_snapshot (id, tenant_id, owner_id, agent_id, version, status, previous_snapshot_id, summary, created_at, activated_at) VALUES (CAST(#{id} AS uuid), #{tenantId}, #{ownerId}, CAST(#{agentId} AS uuid)NULL, #{version}, #{status}, CAST(#{previousSnapshotId} AS uuid)NULL, #{summary}, #{createdAt}, #{activatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE memory_snapshot SET status = #{status}, activated_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'ACTIVE' THEN NOW() ELSE activated_at END WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM memory_snapshot WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)

SELECT * FROM memory_snapshot WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND (agent_id = CAST(#{agentId} AS uuid) OR (agent_id IS NULL AND #{agentId} IS NULL)) ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO memory_snapshot_item (snapshot_id, item_type, item_id) VALUES (CAST(#{snapshotId} AS uuid), #{itemType}, CAST(#{itemId} AS uuid)) ON CONFLICT (snapshot_id, item_type, item_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT snapshot_id AS snapshotId, item_type AS itemType, item_id AS itemId FROM memory_snapshot_item WHERE snapshot_id = CAST(#{snapshotId} AS uuid) ORDER BY item_type, item_id
